summary: MULTISERVICE OVERHALLA AS (org. no. 974 474 530) is a private limited company (AS) based in Overhalla, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1995-06-06. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 95.310 (Reparasjon og vedlikehold av motorvogner). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 20.8 m and net income was NOK 1.9 m. CEO: Frode Randli; board chair: Alf Gisle Lysberg; auditor: BDO AS.
